kultivator.guide.chapter.13.desc: The map, towns, rumours, the sky, ancestral caves and the tower's first ten floors.
kultivator.guide.chapter.14.desc: Rivals, the flying ship, the Underworld, dragons, the sea and the demon prison.
kultivator.guide.c13.peta.title: Open the World Map
kultivator.guide.c13.peta.body:
The World Map card in Scroll › World, the [[key:peta]] key or /kultivasi peta opens the ink map of the world you explored.
The fog lifts within 96 blocks of your path; sites show only after you found them.
Right-click the map to set a waypoint; sect mates share the same map.
kultivator.guide.c13.kota.title: Find a Cultivator Town
kultivator.guide.c13.kota.body:
Towns behind paifang gates grow in new chunks of plains, forests, savannas, taiga, snowy plains and cherry groves, each with its own look.
Reach its gate: the town goes on your map, and no monsters spawn inside.
A Pointer Scroll (paper + amethyst shard + Mid Spirit Stone) can point to the nearest one.
kultivator.guide.c13.teh.title: Hear a rumour
kultivator.guide.c13.teh.body:
At the teahouse pick a tea (meditation, comprehension or a calm heart) or buy a Rumour.
A rumour marks one site you do not know yet on the World Map.
Wanderers sometimes sit in the teahouse waiting for company.
kultivator.guide.c13.lelang.title: Join the dusk auction
kultivator.guide.c13.lelang.body:
The auction house holds a session at dusk while a player is near the auctioneer: five lots, four rival bidders.
Bid +5%, +10% or +25%; spirit stones are only taken when you win.
Consign up to two items per session.
kultivator.guide.c13.pengembara.title: Talk to a wanderer
kultivator.guide.c13.pengembara.body:
Wandering cultivators sometimes walk up in the open. Trade knowledge in a Dao Discussion (three rounds), spar to 10% health, challenge them to a Sword Duel with clashing blades, or challenge to the end.
Winning a discussion gives Dao comprehension or a site note, and sometimes +10 mastery points in a technique of their Dao that you already know.
Sparring and Sword Duels never kill.
kultivator.guide.c13.langit.title: Witness a sky event
kultivator.guide.c13.langit.body:
At dusk the sky sometimes announces a special night: a Spirit Meteor Shower, a Blood Eclipse or Twin Moons.
Spirit meteors land as Spirit Meteor Stones, and now and then a Great Meteor brings a Great Meteor Heart; the eclipse empowers monsters and weakens seals, and monsters it touched can drop an Eclipse Crystal; the twin moons boost Ice and Shadow comprehension.
Vanilla weather and time are never changed.
kultivator.guide.c13.kabut.title: Meditate in Qi mist
kultivator.guide.c13.kabut.body:
Spirit weather changes per region: Thin Qi Mist ×1.2, Dense ×1.5, and Purple Dawn ×1.6 at dawn.
Meditate under the open sky inside the mist; the site multiplier still stays at most ×3.5.
The Weather coin of the World Map shows the mist around you.
kultivator.guide.c13.harta.title: Claim a born treasure
kultivator.guide.c13.harta.body:
A seven-coloured pillar of light marks a newly born treasure of heaven and earth, seen from afar.
While its guardians live the lotus stays sealed: slay them first. Then right-click and stay within 2 blocks for 5 s (cancelled when hit); rival groups race there too.
The World Map marks the pillar with a rainbow ring.
kultivator.guide.c13.gua.title: Clear an ancestral cave
kultivator.guide.c13.gua.body:
Ancestral cave ruins hide in hills, forests and mountains; the Ancient Cave lies in badlands and the deep dark. Inside are a seal gate, formation puzzles, a stone guardian and the inheritance hall.
A wrong move never kills; a hint appears after 90 s.
The inheritance reward is once per player per cave.
kultivator.guide.c14.kapal.title: Launch a flying ship
kultivator.guide.c14.kapal.body:
Craft a Cloud Skiff Keel (planks, white wool, High Spirit Stone) at Golden Core and use it on open ground.
Sit in the stern seat: forward/back speed, left/right rudder, jump up, sprint down; the inventory key opens the Helm.
Fill the hold with spirit stones for fuel.
kultivator.guide.c14.saingan.title: Beat a rival leader
kultivator.guide.c14.saingan.body:
Rival groups race for born treasures and may ambush you after you win.
Beat a leader for a Rival Pouch; the group's grudge drops again.
Towns are safe ground: ambushes never enter a town.
kultivator.guide.c13.menara.title: Conquer ten floors
kultivator.guide.c13.menara.body:
The Hundred-Floor Tower pagoda leads to a lobby in its own dimension; every floor is a trial (waves, puzzles, endurance, the heart, guardians).
Failing sends you to the lobby without losing items.
Every tenth floor holds a milestone chest.
kultivator.guide.c14.bawah.title: Cross the Naihe Bridge
kultivator.guide.c14.bawah.body:
At a Ghost Gate Shrine at night, sneak 3 s at the incense altar holding Soul Incense (Nascent Soul and up).
Your body stays as a mannequin; your soul arrives in the Underworld. Dying as a soul returns you to your body at 1 health.
Cross the bridge to Meng Po and the ten courts.
kultivator.guide.c14.yama.title: Pass the Ten Courts
kultivator.guide.c14.yama.body:
Refuse Meng Po's soup at the end of the Naihe Bridge, then take the courts in order: the Mirror of Retribution, the Ox-Head and Horse-Face duel, the judge's riddle and the lost soul who asks to be led.
Every court gives Soul Jade. At the end King Yama opens the Book of Life and Death: a Soul Lantern and provisions, or (True Immortal) Strike Your Name once.
A deadly blow as a soul never kills you: you wake in your body at 1 health.
kultivator.guide.c14.naga.title: Subdue a wild dragon
kultivator.guide.c14.naga.body:
Wild Jiao glide in the sky (water over seas, cloud over mountains, thunder in storms).
Wear it down to 25%, then use a Dragon-Binding Sash and win the 8-second Duel of Wills.
A tamed dragon can be summoned and ridden.
kultivator.guide.c7.evolusi.title: Evolve a spirit beast
kultivator.guide.c7.evolusi.body:
A tier-3 spirit beast with full XP can face the Spirit Beast Tribulation toward tier 4.
Sneak + use with its offering under the open sky; stand close as its Hu Fa to take 30% of each strike.
Failing never kills your beast.
kultivator.guide.c14.laut.title: Reach the Boundless Sea
kultivator.guide.c14.laut.body:
Enter a Sea Whirlpool holding a Sea-Guide Pearl, or sail a ship on the Sea route from the Helm.
Spirit islands, the Market Isle, the Ao turtle and the Dragon Palace wait on the endless sea.
The Home Gate on every island brings you back.
kultivator.guide.c14.istana.title: Meet the Dragon King
kultivator.guide.c14.istana.body:
The Dragon Palace lies on the floor of the Boundless Sea (Deity Transformation and up). Ao Guang the Dragon King sells Dragon Pearls and gives two quests.
After the first quest his gate guard gives you the Water-Parting Pearl: with it you breathe in this sea's water.
Sea monsters grow stronger the farther you are from the Arrival Harbour.
kultivator.guide.c14.penjara.title: Reseal a demon prison
kultivator.guide.c14.penjara.body:
An ancient demon prison's seal weakens each day and during a Blood Eclipse; pulled talismans weaken it faster.
Strengthen the seal at its heart, or, once broken, light all five pillars during the fight to seal the demon king again; slaying the king also completes this step.
The Seals coin of the World Map shows each seal's strength.
kultivator.guide.c11.kota_abadi.title: Enter the Immortal City
kultivator.guide.c11.kota_abadi.body:
After the ascent to the Immortal Realm, find the floating district of the Immortal City.
The Dao lecture at noon gives comprehension; an Immortal Peach can be picked every three days and also adds +3% Immortal Essence.
Its auctioneer opens the Immortal Auction.
On your first arrival in the Immortal Realm the nearest Immortal City is marked on the World Map at once; a Pointer Scroll (Immortal City kind) can also find it.
kultivator.guide.c14.pelayaran.title: Sail far
kultivator.guide.c14.pelayaran.body:
Pick a destination at the Helm or Sail from a marker card of the World Map while seated at the helm.
Long voyages fly at cruise height and leap 512 blocks through the clouds every 30 s; beware of Sky Pirates. Qi mist and the purple dawn save fuel.
Finish a voyage of more than 3 000 blocks: the Golden Bamboo livery opens.
kultivator.guide.c11.puncak.title: The tower's summit
kultivator.guide.c11.puncak.body:
Floor one hundred of the Hundred-Floor Tower awaits the Shadow Self: your own shadow at full strength.
Win for the title Conqueror of a Hundred Floors.
Each band of ten floors starts at its first floor; no need to climb again.
kultivator.guide.c14.bajak.title: Drive off the sky pirates
kultivator.guide.c14.bajak.body:
On voyages beyond 2 000 blocks a black Sky Pirate raider may draw alongside; the ship sets down and the band leaps beside it.
Fight them near the ship until no foe is left for 10 seconds: spirit-stone spoils by their tier, and the White Cloud livery opens.
A blood eclipse makes them bolder.
